files.README.md:
# Brindle & Crane Tea Merchants

Pull orders for the cafe and restaurant channels, September 2026. One row per order.
The export job retried twice during the month, so a few orders appear on more than one
row; every row for the same order is identical in all four columns.
files.docs/carrier-notes.txt:
Purolator pickup window 14:00-16:00 on weekdays.
Cafe channel orders ship on the mixed pallet run; restaurants get dedicated trucks.

turns.prompt: Brindle & Crane needs the September cafe figures for the freight recap. How many cafe orders went out in September 2026? Just the number.
Finance wants the weekly view instead of the monthly one. How many cafe orders shipped in the week of Monday 14 September to Sunday 20 September? The bare number, please.
And how many crates went to cafes in that same week? Number only.
